key_idea: A name is absent exactly when the next line is not the literal 'Present!'.
sketch: Read all N lines; for each line that is not 'Present!' check whether the following line is 'Present!'; if not (or it is the last line) print the name. Print 'No Absences' if nothing was printed. Pitfall: a student may be named 'Present' (no exclamation mark), so compare against the exact token 'Present!'. O(N).
